verdict.rationale: The evidence shows OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs that third-party clients can be pointed at manually, plus LocalAI's own `local-ai chat` shell agent. Nothing documents a single command that launches third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured for local models. API compatibility only enables a manual user-side setup, and the first-party chat agent is a different feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command
